scenario: The ego vehicle changes lanes to avoid a stationary obstacle in its path while another vehicle travels in the adjacent lane.

ego.behavior: The car changes lanes to the left to avoid an obstacle and continues traveling forward.

adversarials.behavior: The car travels straight forward in the right lane, maintaining its position parallel to the ego vehicle's original path.

spatial_relation: The ego vehicle starts in the right lane of a two-lane straight road, with a stationary obstacle directly ahead in the same lane, and an adversarial car traveling in the left lane adjacent to the ego.
requirements_and_restrictions: The ego vehicle must initiate a lane change before reaching the stationary obstacle, and the scenario terminates once the ego has successfully merged into the left lane and passed the obstacle.

temporary_modifications.position: Positioned directly in the center of the ego vehicle's right lane, blocking forward progress.

reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: The ego is the lower car in the right lane from a top-down perspective; the other car is adversarial. 2. Enumeration: one adversarial car. 3. Chronology: initially ego approaches obstacle in right lane with adversarial car in left lane; midpoint ego initiates left lane change; ending ego completes merge into left lane. 4. Evidence: dashed arrow shows ego's leftward trajectory toward left lane; solid obstacle blocks right lane; adversarial car maintains straight path in left lane.
